title: Growth Hacker Marketing
author: Ryan Holiday
reason: Marketing primer teaches the practitioner how to acquire, retain and test customer growth. Its professional-skills purpose, rather than a sustained history or explanatory study of an industry, establishes H3. Evidence: https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/315135/growth-hacker-marketing-by-ryan-holiday/9781591847380/

title: Guerrilla Marketing
author: Jay Conrad Levinson
reason: Practical small-business marketing manual develops proficiency in advertising methods, campaigns, copy and marketing plans. H3 applies before judgments of commercial value or age. Evidence: https://books.google.com/books/about/Guerrilla_marketing.html?id=hl1EAAAAYAAJ

title: Stuck? Diagrams Help.
author: Abby Covert
reason: Author explicitly states that the book teaches how to diagram, including what to do first, next and last and how to assess success. title: The Science of Storytelling
author: Will Storr
reason: Applies psychology and neuroscience to teaching better storytelling and novel/script craft.
